summary: Frontend-only mobile-web (390x844) verification of AzoApp Partner iteration 66 — floating bottom nav on every sub-page, Help & Support restyle, interactive charts on Analytics + Dashboard, and #0659B2 theme. Login via 'Maybe later' → 'Partner Demo' works. Bottom nav (testID app-bottom-nav) is visible on ALL 10 partner sub-pages tested (/partner/analytics, /availability, /earnings, /invoices, /payouts, /rewards, /starter-kit, /verification, /history, /notifications) plus /partner/support and /partner/support/<id> thread; tab-more shows the blue-gradient highlight on every sub-page. Tapping tab-dashboard/tab-job/tab-wallet from support navigates to /, /jobs, /wallet correctly. Support page shows exact strings '🛟 Help & Support' + 'N tickets · chat with our support team, attach screenshots, track status.', green 'New Ticket' (testID new-ticket), support-search, support-range=All time, support-status=All statuses, support-sort=Newest first; dashed empty card with 'New Ticket' (new-ticket-empty) when list is empty; New Ticket bottom sheet has ticket-subject, ticket-message, submit-ticket → POST /api/support/tickets returned 200 and new ticket 'Test from mobile parity' (TKT-100006, open, medium, just now) appeared at top; ticket count went 0→5 (existing seeded rows shown). Tapping the row navigates to /partner/support/fefbcff1-... thread page and bottom nav remains visible. Analytics: Earnings Trend line-chart tap produced dark tooltip with '2026-09-13 ● Earnings: ₹0'; Jobs per Day bar-chart tap produced tooltip with '2026-08-31 ● Jobs: 1'; Status Split legend row status-completed (also status-started/status-paid) tap toggles slice highlight/opacity without navigating. Dashboard Earnings trend tap produced tooltip '2026-09-07 ● Earnings: ₹0'. Theme verified: Withdraw button backgroundColor = rgb(6, 89, 178) = #0659B2, active tab-dashboard gradient = linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(9,124,246), rgb(6,89,178)) using primary #0659B2 + secondary #097CF6. Regression: /, /jobs, /active, /wallet, /partner/starter-kit render with no red-box (no [data-testid=error-screen]) and nav visible; starter-kit-owned view still renders (from previous mock purchase). NO 'Unknown event handler property' warning in the console across every page tested. No page errors. Only console warning present is expected: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' (harmless on web).
action_items: No functional issues found in this iteration — ship-ready.

Optional/minor: On mobile web the BarChart/LineChart Pressables occupy full width including area that overlaps the floating bottom nav shadow; if the chart is at the bottom of the ScrollView the tap on the lower ~40px can be intercepted by the nav. Consider adding paddingBottom (e.g., insets.bottom + 90) to the analytics/dashboard ScrollView's contentContainerStyle so the last card is always fully above the nav. (Not blocking — scrolling reveals the chart above the nav and taps work fine.)
critical_code_review_comments: analytics.tsx line 38: BarChart.onTap ignores taps that fall on the axis-label row (y > innerH+padT) but still sets a selection based on x; it works but semantically a tap outside the chart plot area could still open a tooltip pointing to a bar. Minor.

(partner)/_layout.tsx line 42: hard-coded list of sub-page names is fragile; if a new file under app/(partner)/partner/ is added the tab bar will show it unless it's also added here. Consider a glob/dynamic mapping or file-based convention (e.g., name.startsWith('partner/') → href:null).

AppTabBar.tsx line 156: `badge && badge > 0` is fine, but when badge is undefined the guard falls through — safe here since badges is Record<string, number>, just worth typing the prop as `badge?: number`.

support/index.tsx: creating a ticket calls the mutation which refetches the list; on slow networks the modal closes before the list refresh completes and the user might not see immediate feedback — consider optimistic insert or a spinner in the header count.
seed_data_creation: Created one support ticket on demo partner (+919000000003 / AZP4587602 Raj Kumar): TKT-100006 subject 'Test from mobile parity', message 'Hello, mobile parity test message.', priority medium, status open. This is the only side-effect from this test run; the partner had 4 seeded tickets before (total is now 5).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo partner AZP4587602 (Raj Kumar, +919000000003) now has 5 support tickets including the fresh TKT-100006 created in this iteration. Starter Kit for this partner is still in the OWNED state from iteration 65. Auth: onboarding notifications screen appears first (tap 'Maybe later'), then Login (tap 'Partner Demo'). Use viewport 390x844. All partner sub-pages live under the Tabs group so app-bottom-nav is always present; the More tab is auto-highlighted on any /partner/* route. To hit a chart tooltip reliably in a script, scroll the parent ScrollView so the chart is in the upper half of the viewport (window.scrollBy doesn't work — walk parents looking for overflowY:auto with scrollHeight>clientHeight and set scrollTop).
rca_of_issue:
N/A — no bugs found. Test verification highlights:
- BOTTOM NAV: verified on 12 partner routes (/, jobs, active, wallet, analytics, availability, earnings, invoices, payouts, rewards, starter-kit, verification, history, notifications, support, support/<id>). Every one had [data-testid=app-bottom-nav] and none rendered [data-testid=error-screen].
- MORE HIGHLIGHT: on every sub-page tab-more contained a linear-gradient child (blue → dark blue), meaning it renders the focused state.
- THEME: getComputedStyle(Withdraw button) = rgb(6, 89, 178); tab-dashboard focused gradient = 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(9, 124, 246), rgb(6, 89, 178))'. Both match the requested #0659B2 primary + #097CF6 secondary palette.
- CHART TOOLTIPS: line-chart on analytics returned '2026-09-13 · Earnings: ₹0'; bar-chart returned '2026-08-31 · Jobs: 1'; dashboard line-chart returned '2026-09-07 · Earnings: ₹0'. Status-completed legend tap kept URL at /partner/analytics and visually reduced opacity of other slices (verified via screenshot showing Completed slice widened).
- SUPPORT FLOW: POST /api/support/tickets → 200; refetch GET /api/support/tickets → 200; new ticket rendered at top with 'just now'. Tap on ticket row navigated to /partner/support/<uuid> thread page (TKT-100006 header + 'Hello, mobile parity test message.' bubble) with bottom nav still visible.
- CONSOLE: 0 'Unknown event handler property' warnings; 0 pageerror events across all pages.
